text:
rachel (product): quick thread  customers want contractable deliverables for enterprise compliance: precise SLOs, acceptance tests, and what well put in the MSA for audit logs + BYOK + retention. keep it short and actionable.
sam (eng): agreed. tech constraints to call out up-front: hot index cost for recent forensics, export pagination for long ranges, and BYOK = key-ref only (we never persist raw keys). also note continuous batching impacts export ordering.
amar (security): must include: attestation options (partner HSM vs cloud KMS), key-rotation report, and proof-of-deletion semantics (what we mark as tombstone vs cryptographic wipe). SOC2/ISO auditors want deterministic export schema and signed export manifests.
leo (sales): two pilots: NovaBank requires HSM attestation + 7y WORM storage; Appicity will accept cloud-KMS + 90d. Both ask for written acceptance tests tied to contract payments.
toni (custeng): Appicity needs fast forensic sampling: ability to run a "fast-path" export for last 30m -> single-page NDJSON under 60s. They're fine with paginated exports for >90d windows.
maddie (legal): contract pointers: 1) Acceptance = pass scoped tests in staging + delivery of a signed export sample; 2) Define retention lanes (90d, 1y, 7y) and explicit export latency SLAs per lane; 3) No "absolute deletion" without specifying TTLs and escrow options. Also include SLA credit formula for missed exports.
rachel (product): propose minimal deliverables (MVP): - API-level BYOK handshake (cloud-KMS only) + handshake audit entries - 90d hot index with on-demand NDJSON export and fast-path for recent queries - tenant retention flag + TTL job + tombstone marker in exports. Phase 2: partner-attestation, WORM cold storage, legal-hold API.
sam (eng): API sketches to include in spec: ```POST /v1/keystore/handshake {"key_ref": "projects/.../keys/123"} -> 200 {"handshake_id":"h_abc"}``` ```GET /v1/audit/export?tenant=tid&start=...&end=...&page=1``` returns NDJSON chunk. We'll add example NDJSON record with fields: request_id, timestamp, tenant_id, route, model_version, kms_key_ref, chain_of_custody_id.
amar (security): acceptance test checklist (suggested): 1) BYOK handshake: ingest key-ref -> audit row present with handshake status + attestation_token if applicable. 2) Forensics fast-path: request recent 30m export -> first page returned <60s and rows include required fields. 3) Retention enforcement: set retention=7y -> simulate TTL run -> export shows tombstone marker with deletion_timestamp and prior export preserved as chain-of-custody entry. 4) Rotation resilience: rotate key in KMS -> system can still decrypt archived evidence via escrow keyref/rotated-key mapping.
leo (sales): customers will want these acceptance tests in the SOW. can we produce acceptance-run script they can run or a signed report after staging run?
maddie (legal): yes; require signed manifest from us (SHA256 over NDJSON) plus timestamp and product-signer identity. Thats the deliverable to attach to acceptance sign-off.
toni (custeng): operational ask: include an "export-sample" endpoint that returns a small sampled NDJSON for quick legal review (e.g., ?sample=100). also need rate limits documented.
sam (eng): doable. will include `?sample=` param and rate-limit headers. cost note: 7y WORM exports may require rehydration; add cost estimate and opt-in billing for long-term retention.
amar (security): partner-attestation plan: list partners + required attestation token format. for pilot we can offer partner-attestation as professional services. add threat-model addendum and regression keys for test harness.
infra-bot: ticket COMP-84055 created: "Contractable compliance deliverables: BYOK handshake, export SLAs, retention lanes" assigned to product/eng/security/legal.
maddie (legal): draft contract language: acceptance clause references ticket COMP-84055, defines SLOs (fast-path <60s for recent sample, export completion for 1h range <30m for pilot), signed export manifest requirement, rollback window (30 days to dispute), and SLA credits calculation. avoid absolute deletion guarantees.
rachel (product): next steps: sam + amar -> tech spec + example signed manifest + test harness by EOW; maddie -> draft MSA clause and SOW template; leo -> lock pilot order for NovaBank vs Appicity; toni -> prepare test dataset for Appicity. keep MVP narrow and make Phase 2 explicit. :white_check_mark:
